page_topic_one_liner: SEO learning path — resources, courses, official docs, expert blogs, and step-by-step skill progression
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional SEO education and learning-roadmap content, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a visual learning-path / curriculum board with milestone modules (keywords → technical → content → links), NOT an AI tutor or chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Vertical SEO learning roadmap — 4 stepped milestone cards connected by dotted path (Keyword Research → Technical SEO → Content → Link Building), each card torn-paper with blurred module labels and small book/tool icons
Secondary: stacked resource bookmark tabs (Moz, Ahrefs, Search Central style generic blog favicon blurs, no real logos)
Tertiary: checklist notepad with 3 checked learning tasks and pencil mark
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is SEO learning not GEO)
Generic graduation cap alone without SEO module roadmap
Affiliate dashboard or course checkout UI unrelated to SEO learning path
